name: Melody of Hearts
source:
Melody of Hearts is a music-themed dating simulator/rhythm game hybrid. Capture the heart (beats) of these gorgeous instrument (players) with careful choices and skillful playing. Your decisions during the rhythm game affect the outcome of the storyline. Try to achieve a good ending with your favorite characters!

[From [url=https://jxu12345.itch.io/melody-of-hearts]Itch.io[/url]]
